title: Dockerizing a Multi-Container Application
description: Package a web application consisting of a frontend interface, a backend API, and a database into Docker containers and orchestrate them using Docker Compose.
requirements: Write optimized Dockerfiles for both frontend and backend services
Configure container networking and volume mounts for the database
Use environment variables to connect frontend, backend, and db
Orchestrate startup order and auto-restarts with docker-compose.yml
checklist: Create optimized multi-stage Dockerfile for the frontend
Create Dockerfile for the backend API server
Set up docker-compose.yml defining frontend, backend, and database
Implement environment files (.env) to configure credentials
Run docker-compose up and verify application communication
